_note: Literature radar for the monthly data-refresh Action. Each topic is a tuned Europe PMC query (keyless, covers PubMed + PMC + Agricola + preprints) for a figure the map cares about. The Action reports papers published in the last `days_window` days per topic — candidates for a human (or the optional v2 LLM triage) to judge; it NEVER auto-ingests. Broad queries are noisy, so queries are TITLE-scoped; widen/narrow here as needed.
_ledger_note: With --triage, the LLM only reads each abstract into facts (layer, countries, data year, dataset); scripts/triage_rules.py keeps a paper only if its data are newer than what this ledger says the map uses for that country and layer. Remove `ledger` to fall back to the plain keep/drop rubric.

topics.label: Global dementia prevalence / burden
topics.query: TITLE:dementia AND TITLE:(prevalence OR burden OR incidence) AND TITLE:(global OR worldwide OR regional OR national)

topics.label: Lancet Commission on dementia (risk factors / RRs)
MCI prevalence (meta-analysis / pooled)
topics.query: TITLE:"mild cognitive impairment" AND TITLE:(prevalence OR incidence) AND (meta-analysis OR pooled OR systematic)

topics.label: Subjective cognitive decline prevalence
topics.query: TITLE:"subjective cognitive decline" AND TITLE:(prevalence OR incidence OR estimate)

topics.label: Air pollution / PM2.5 and dementia risk
topics.query: TITLE:("air pollution" OR "PM2.5" OR "particulate matter") AND TITLE:(dementia OR "cognitive decline" OR "cognitive impairment")

topics.label: Population ageing / 65+ projections
topics.query: TITLE:("population ageing" OR "population aging" OR "demographic ageing") AND TITLE:(global OR projection OR projections OR forecast OR trends OR prospects)

topics.label: Global risk-factor prevalence (HTN / diabetes / obesity / smoking / inactivity)
topics.query: TITLE:(hypertension OR diabetes OR obesity OR smoking OR "physical inactivity") AND TITLE:(global OR worldwide OR "national trends") AND TITLE:(prevalence OR trends)

topics.label: 🇹🇼 Taiwan dementia / cognitive impairment (often excluded from global DBs)
topics.query: TITLE:Taiwan AND TITLE:(dementia OR "cognitive impairment" OR "cognitive decline" OR "mild cognitive")
manual_also: 內政部戶政司 — 65+/超高齡人口 (Taiwan is absent from World Bank): https://www.ris.gov.tw/app/portal/346
衛福部國健署 NHIS — 吸菸/身體活動不足等危險因子: https://www.hpa.gov.tw/
台灣失智症協會 / NHRI — 全國失智盛行率調查: http://www.tada2002.org.tw/About/IsntDementia
topics.note: Because of Taiwan's geopolitical status it is routinely excluded from GBD / WHO GHO / World Bank, so global sources will NOT surface Taiwan updates — this topic + the manual gov sources above are how we catch them.
